world.title: ‘We’ve got four little kids, wife never loved politics’: JD Vance says he may skip 2028 presidential race
world.summary: US Vice President JD Vance has indicated he might not pursue a presidential run in 2028. He cited his wife, Usha Vance, and their four young children as significant factors in his decision. Vance noted that his wife has never been fond of politics, which influences his considerations regarding a potential candidacy for the upcoming election.

world.title: Buildings ablaze, petrol bombs hurled at parliament: 10 visuals show chaos of Albania protests
world.summary: Protests in Tirana, Albania, escalated into violent clashes between demonstrators and riot police. Protesters hurled rocks and petrol bombs, leading to several injuries. The unrest stemmed from anti-government sentiments, with buildings reportedly ablaze amid the chaos. The situation reflects growing discontent among citizens, resulting in significant confrontations with law enforcement during the ongoing demonstrations against the government.

world.title: On Iran, Israel’s opposition is even more hawkish than Netanyahu
world.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu faces criticism from opposition parties, which argue he has not taken a strong enough stance against Iran. Following a military assault on Iran in February, the Israeli government received significant public support. Opposition factions have rallied behind the military action, indicating that their positions are even more hawkish than Netanyahu's approach towards Iran.

business.title: Nepal bans import, sales of Indian biscuit Priyagold
business.summary: Nepalese authorities have prohibited the import, sale, and distribution of Priyagold biscuits, produced by Surya Food and Agro Ltd in India. The ban was announced through an official notice on Monday, citing concerns over food safety regulations. This decision reflects ongoing scrutiny of imported food products in Nepal, aiming to ensure compliance with local health standards.

business.title: Bajaj Finance Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 29% YoY to Rs 6,367 crore, NII up 24%
business.summary: Bajaj Finance reported a 29% year-on-year increase in net profit for Q2, reaching Rs 6,367 crore, up from Rs 4,948 crore. Net interest income rose 24% to Rs 13,335 crore, compared to Rs 10,785 crore in the same quarter last year. Additionally, total income increased by 23% to Rs 15,974 crore from Rs 12,982 crore.

business.title: Bajaj Finance Q2 results: Net profit rises 29% to Rs 6,266 crore, NII increases 24%
business.summary: Bajaj Finance reported a 29% increase in net profit, reaching Rs 6,266 crore for Q2 ended September 30, 2026. The company's net interest income (NII) rose by 24%, contributing to its financial growth. Additionally, assets under management (AUM) increased by 26%, totaling Rs 5.84 lakh crore, reflecting the company's strong performance in the financial sector.

technology.title: The Big AI Terms Everyone Is Getting Wrong: Open Source, Open Weight And Proprietary
technology.summary: Many AI models and platforms are labeled as "open source," but much of this designation is misleading. Terms such as proprietary, open source, and open weight are often confused or used interchangeably, leading to misunderstandings about the nature of these technologies. Clarifying these terms is essential for accurate discussions about AI's accessibility and ownership.

technology.title: Reliance Digital Offers iPhone 17 Pro At Rs 56,990: Exchange Benefits And Conditions Explained
technology.summary: Reliance Digital is offering the iPhone 17 Pro at an effective price of Rs 56,990, down from its launch price of Rs 1,34,900 for the 256GB variant. To achieve this price, customers must utilize a combination of in-store discounts, exchange benefits, and bank cashback. The offer aims to make the premium device more accessible to buyers.

technology.title: Amazon's New AI Wearables: What Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse Can Do
technology.summary: Amazon has launched two new AI wearables, Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse, on October 15, 2026. These devices aim to transform everyday conversations into summaries, reminders, and actionable tasks. The new products expand Amazon's personal AI lineup, providing users with tools to retain important details from discussions without the need for manual note-taking. Pricing and additional features are also detailed.

sports.title: ‘It’s very simple’ - Luis Enrique talks trying to stop Lamine Yamal and Barcelona
sports.summary: Luis Enrique discussed strategies to counter Lamine Yamal and Barcelona ahead of their match in Paris. He emphasized that maintaining possession is key to defending against Yamal, acknowledging the challenge posed by Barcelona's playing style. Enrique noted the importance of focusing on his team's capabilities while preparing for the difficult task of facing a strong opponent like Barça.

sports.title: Svitolina announces end of marriage to Monfils as Ukrainian cites toll of war
sports.summary: Elina Svitolina, ranked sixth in the world, announced on Monday the end of her marriage to former tennis player Gael Monfils. The Ukrainian cited the emotional toll of Russia's war in her homeland as a significant factor, stating that she needs to rediscover herself. The couple's decision comes amid ongoing challenges related to the conflict in Ukraine.

sports.title: Ramesh Powar appointed to men's selection committee; Pragyan Ojha named Chairperson
sports.summary: Ramesh Powar has been appointed to the men's selection committee, replacing Ajit Agarkar, who recently stepped down. The committee will be chaired by Pragyan Ojha. Powar's appointment was unanimously recommended, and he joins the panel based on his experience and seniority in Test cricket. This change aims to strengthen the committee's decision-making for future selections.

health.title: A shot at a cervical cancer-free generation
health.summary: India faces a significant cervical cancer crisis, contributing to 25% of global deaths from the disease. Many women endure fertility loss due to surgical interventions. The article emphasizes the urgent need for awareness, prevention, and vaccination to combat this public health issue. Efforts are underway to promote a cervical cancer-free generation, highlighting the importance of addressing this health challenge.

health.title: Ashwagandha Standards Alliance expands membership and drafts technical standards
health.summary: The Ashwagandha Standards Alliance (ASA) has expanded its membership by adding six new members. The alliance is working on a technical standards framework aimed at addressing analytical variability, product identity, and labeling accuracy. This initiative responds to increasing regulatory scrutiny and scientific research surrounding ashwagandha supplements and ingredients, enhancing quality standards in the industry.

health.title: What Tiny Plastics Leave in Water: Heat and Time Intensify Toxic Effects in Lab Tests
health.summary: A laboratory study revealed that water contaminated with three common plastics negatively impacted seed germination and altered bull sperm movement. The research indicated that smaller plastic fragments, higher preparation temperatures, and prolonged exposure to water intensified these toxic effects. The findings suggest that plastic pollution releases harmful substances that can disrupt biological processes in aquatic environments.

science.title: Ancient Japanese populations survived a mega volcanic eruption in the ocean 7,300 years ago
science.summary: A volcanic eruption occurred under the sea near southern Japan nearly 7,300 years ago, previously thought to cause widespread devastation. Recent research indicates that ancient populations adapted to the environmental changes and survived. The study highlights the resilience of these communities in the face of powerful earthquakes and tsunamis triggered by the eruption, allowing them to thrive afterward.

science.title: SpaceX’s Falcon 9 to put 32 payloads in orbit: All you need to know about Bandwagon-5
science.summary: SpaceX plans to launch its Falcon 9 rocket on October 20 for the Bandwagon-5 rideshare mission, which will carry 32 payloads, including cubesats, microsats, and reentry vehicles. This mission will be the booster’s 19th flight. The first stage of the rocket is set to land on the A Shortfall of Gravitas droneship in the Atlantic Ocean.

science.title: In a first, Europe’s Proba-3 and India’s Aditya-L1 spacecraft jointly observe early stage CMEs
science.summary: Europe's Proba-3 and India's Aditya-L1 spacecraft have jointly observed coronal mass ejections (CMEs) from different vantage points for the first time. This collaboration has provided scientists with new insights into the evolution of CMEs. The observations mark a significant milestone in solar research, enhancing understanding of solar phenomena and their potential impacts on space weather and Earth.

entertainment.title: Female desire is not the problem, harassment is
entertainment.summary: Actor Rishikanth, known for his roles in "Modha Rathri" and "Dorothy," has experienced a dramatic shift in public perception since their releases. Initially celebrated, he now faces harassment both online and offline. This situation highlights the broader issue of harassment in public spaces, emphasizing that female desire is not the problem, but rather the inappropriate responses it can provoke.

entertainment.title: American comedian Hasan Minhaj trolled for saying Indians order their dal with ‘dharka’ on top
entertainment.summary: American comedian Hasan Minhaj faced lighthearted trolling after stating that Indians sometimes order their dal with extra “dharka” on top. His comment sparked confusion among viewers, leading to a mix of reactions on social media. The remark was made during a recent interview, highlighting Minhaj's comedic take on cultural nuances, which resonated with some while baffling others.

entertainment.title: Sara Ali Khan and Amrita Singh lease out 2,545 sq ft Mumbai office for Rs 3.76 crore over five years, with starting rent of Rs 5.85 lakh, deal includes 5% annual hike - Report
entertainment.summary: Sara Ali Khan and her mother, Amrita Singh, have leased a 2,545 sq ft commercial office space in Andheri West, Mumbai, for Rs 3.76 crore over five years. The agreement includes a starting rent of Rs 5.85 lakh per month, with a 5% annual increase. The space will be occupied by an artificial intelligence studio company.
